title: Descent of constant-module direct-image germs to a stage
statement: Fix a universe u, a commutative ring Lambda : Type (u+1), a Lambda-module M, schemes X and Y in universe u, a small cofiltered category I in universe u, a diagram D : I -> Scheme with affine transition maps, morphisms p_i : D_i -> X which are quasi-compact and quasi-separated, and compatibility equations hp_g : D(g) followed by p_j = p_i for every g : i -> j. Let nu : Y -> X be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, pi : const(Y) -> D a natural transformation, hpi_i : pi_i followed by p_i = nu for every i, and hc a proof that (Y,pi) is a limit cone. For every point s of X, let T_s be the module-valued fiber functor at the universe-lifted algebraic closure geometric point of s. Write A_i = p_i,* of the constant M-sheaf on D_i and B = nu_* of the constant M-sheaf on Y. For every x in T_s(B), there exist i in I and y in T_s(A_i) such that T_s(constantModulePushforwardMap(Lambda,M,p_i,nu,pi_i,hpi_i))(y) = x. No sheaf diagram K, comparison cocone, or chosen colimit is part of this statement.

source.place: Tag 09Z1, proof on affine etale neighborhoods, p = 0; Tag 09Z6, finite approximation paragraph

proof.text: Replace the opposite of the small cofiltered category by a final functor from a nonempty directed partial order. Its opposite is initial, and the restricted cone is still limiting; a representative at a restricted stage is also a representative at an original stage.

The inverse image on the limit of each constant M-sheaf is constant M. The pullback identity/composition and unit equations identify the transitions with identities. The colimit of this nonempty connected constant diagram is constant M.

Represent the target fiber germ over an affine etale neighborhood U. Base change preserves the inverse limit, affine transitions and qcqs hypotheses. Apply the stated degree-zero higher direct image continuity isomorphism to the underlying abelian constant sheaves after reindexing. Identify degree-zero higher direct image with ordinary direct image and the colimit of the pulled-back constant diagram with the constant sheaf. The adjunction units and constant pullback and direct-image composition identifications make its components constantModulePushforwardMap. Apply the geometric fiber, which preserves filtered colimits. The underlying filtered colimit of abelian groups has a stage representative for every element. The module-to-abelian forgetful functor identifies the underlying elements of the source and target fibers and commutes with these canonical maps, so this stage representative and equality also give a module germ. This uses the continuity theorem statement, not a stronger representative assertion extracted from its proof. No preservation of module-sheaf colimits is required.

theorem exists_constantModule_limit_fiber_rep
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (p : ∀ i, D.obj i ⟶ X)
    (hp : ∀ {i j : I} (g : i ⟶ j), D.map g ≫ p j = p i)
    [∀ {i j : I} (g : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map g)]
    [∀ i : I, QuasiCompact (p i)] [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparated (p i)]
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} (ν : Y ⟶ X)
    (π : (Functor.const I).obj Y ⟶ D) (hπ : ∀ i, π.app i ≫ p i = ν)
    [QuasiCompact ν] [QuasiSeparated ν]
    (hc : IsLimit (Cone.mk Y π))
    (s : X)
    (x : ((X.uliftPointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj
        ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))) :
    ∃ (i : I) (y : ((X.uliftPointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber
        (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj
      ((lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) (p i)).obj
        ((constantSheaf (D.obj i).smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M))),
      (((X.uliftPointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map
        (constantModulePushforwardMap Λ M _ _ (π.app i) (hπ i))) y = x
